descriptionMarkdown:
A Nilaus inspired base in a book for a full Nauvis starter base for the Space Exploration version 0.7 mod.

Provides everything you need to produce supplies, science, and launch rockets. 

use the combinators to identify where to connect raw materials

the first base should be the starter base with the steel furnances. Once you have researched them, replace the base with  the industrial furnaces blueprint and upgrade to blue belts. use speed modules to increase steel production.

the exo base is basically the main base with basic science production removed. Rocket science remains as it is useful throughout the game.

For the space hub, make sure that the space platform assembler has access to a requester chest before you depart so it can continue to make platforms.

If you find any errors or issues with the base, let me know and I will try to update the blueprint
title: Space Exploration Starter Base
